capabilities.description: Shows the main dashboard figures for the user's branch, such as how much fee money was collected today or this month and how much is still outstanding, each with the time it was calculated. Which figures appear depends on the user's role. Not for the list of families behind an outstanding figure - use fee.overdue.list.

effect.reply_template: {branch_name}, as of {calculated_at}: {collected_today} collected today and {collected_this_month} this month; {total_outstanding} still outstanding.

capabilities.description: Proposes cancelling a fee charge that should never have been raised and against which nothing has been paid, such as an invoice billed to the wrong student or a duplicate invoice. It cancels nothing on its own: a School Admin must approve it. Not for a wrong charge the family has already paid - use fee.credit.raise. Not for a correct debt the school will never collect - use fee.writeoff.propose. Not for removing only a late fee - use fee.latefee.waive.

effect.confirmation_template: Propose cancelling {invoice_label} because: {reason}. Nothing is cancelled until a School Admin approves.
effect.notifies: the School Admin who approves cancellations
effect.reply_template: Cancellation {cancellation_id} proposed for {invoice_label}. It now waits for approval.

capabilities.description: Proposes crediting a fee charge that was wrong but has already been paid, holding the money on the family's account so it reduces their next bill rather than being handed back. It credits nothing on its own: a School Admin must approve it. Not for a wrong charge nobody has paid yet - use fee.cancellation.raise. Not for a correct debt the school will never collect - use fee.writeoff.propose. Not for removing only a late fee - use fee.latefee.waive.

capabilities.description: Waives a late fee that has already been charged to a family, removing the fine from their invoice while both the fine and its waiver stay on record. One fine at a time, each with its own reason. Not for cancelling or crediting the fee charge itself - use fee.cancellation.raise or fee.credit.raise. Not for writing off an unpaid debt - use fee.writeoff.propose.

capabilities.description: Proposes writing off a correctly charged fee debt that the school will never collect, for example because the family cannot be traced or cannot pay, with an account of what was done to recover it. It writes off nothing on its own: the Principal must approve it. Not for a charge raised in error - use fee.cancellation.raise, or fee.credit.raise if it was paid. Not for removing only a late fee - use fee.latefee.waive.
